## Description

An `ADVANCED_FACE` has its outer wire wound clockwise (when the surface normal is taken as outward) and its inner wires wound counter-clockwise — i.e., the orientations are swapped relative to the convention. Bug-reporter language: "wire winds wrong way", "outer loop reversed", "hole oriented as outer".

## Reproducer recipe

`ADVANCED_FACE` whose outer `EDGE_LOOP` traces vertices in the wrong direction relative to the surface normal.

## Expected kernel behavior

Detect via signed-area in UV; flip the offending loop, or reject the face.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
